title: 对手也是客户：中立平台服务20万模型，如何与对手共赢？
speaker: Mary Ann Sung

segments.en: It is a very well asked question.
We've been asked this question repeatedly.
segments.zh: 我们经常被问到这个问题。

segments.en: Since the founding of our time, we committed to be neutral open source platform.
segments.zh: 自成立以来，我们致力于成为中立、开源的平台。

segments.en: We worked with old model companies and we worked with old compute companies.
segments.zh: 我们与老牌模型公司和算力公司都有合作。

segments.en: And hence, with that, now our virtual GPU is able to provide more than 200,000 of models for our enterprise customers.
segments.zh: 因此，我们的虚拟GPU现在能够为企业客户提供超过20万个模型。

segments.en: So many of those, what you mentioned about competitors in the marketplace are actually very good long-term trusted partners of ours that we also service as paying customers.
segments.zh: 您提到的许多市场竞争对手，实际上是我们长期信赖的合作伙伴，他们也是我们的付费客户。
